title: Rewrite README as high-level project overview with key diagrams

comments.author: home
comments.text: Intent: rewrite the main README.md from a CLI-usage/programmer page into a high-level project overview (what BotSpy is, read-only local reading of Claude Code/Cursor/Codex/Grok Bot/Antigravity histories, one normalized schema, local SQLite store with FTS + vector search, everything local/privacy). Move a small selection of docs diagrams up into the README with the docs picture light/dark pattern, using absolute raw-dot-githubusercontent URLs at the repo org so the image links also work on crates.io. Detailed CLI and library usage moves to a short Learn-more section linking docs pages; any CLI detail not already covered goes into docs/cli.md (not deleted). docs/ pages stay unchanged otherwise. Diagram picks: C4 context, top-level dataflow, C4 containers. Worktree /private/tmp/botspy-readme, branch cursor/readme-overview-fb2c, PR into develop.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Progress: README rewritten as high-level overview (intro, C4 context, what BotSpy does, dataflow, containers, everything-stays-local, compact agent table, install, Learn-more links to docs pages, license). Three diagrams embedded with absolute raw URLs (context, dataflow, containers) — all six PNGs verified reachable on origin/develop; no new PNGs added to the crate. tests/no_real_personal_data.rs: added a README.md exemption for the org-name needle because the crates.io readme must embed raw URLs at the repository (same rationale as the existing Cargo.toml exemption). docs/cli.md gained the detail that was README-only: sources and doctor example transcripts, the missing-source note, and the synthetic-corpus disclaimer. fmt and clippy -D warnings pass locally. Full cargo test running.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: PR 16 opened into develop (branch cursor/readme-overview-fb2c, commits b68ccf1 docs rewrite plus 17cefc0 board state). Pre-push checks clean: no agent-email or home-path strings in history, README free of personal data. Local gates green: fmt, clippy -D warnings, full cargo test (64 lib tests; BDD 40 features, 213 scenarios, 211 passed and 2 skipped; fixture guards, personal-data guard, spec_docs_coverage, 8 doc tests). Waiting for CI, then merge.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: CI on PR 16 flagged the personal-data guard: six event files from this session carry actor_id stamped from the machine username, which collides with the anonymized actor id the guard forbids. The shared kbs daemon was started without KANBUS_USER and stamped the events; stopping the daemon and running kbs with KANBUS_USER=example-user fixes the stamping. Sanitizing those six actor_id values now, same class of operation as the earlier anonymize-board-data chore.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Merged: PR 16 landed on develop as merge commit 7e727f3. The README is now a high-level project overview: intro, C4 context, what-it-does bullets, top-level data flow, containers view, local-only guarantees, compact agent table, install, and a Learn-more section linking the docs pages. Three diagrams moved up with absolute raw URLs so they render on crates.io too (context, dataflow, containers); no new PNGs in the crate. README-only CLI detail (sources and doctor transcripts, missing-source note, synthetic-corpus disclaimer) moved into docs/cli.md. tests/no_real_personal_data.rs gained a README.md exemption for the org-name needle (crates.io readme must embed raw URLs at the repository, like Cargo.toml). Gates: fmt and clippy clean; full cargo test green locally (64 lib tests, BDD 40 features / 213 scenarios with 2 skipped, guards incl. spec_docs_coverage and no_real_personal_data, 8 doc tests); CI green on all 8 jobs before merge. One wrinkle fixed on the way: six session event files carried actor_id stamped from the machine username by a daemon started without KANBUS_USER; sanitized to the anonymized actor id and future kbs calls run with KANBUS_USER set.
